notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token with haste.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.
